notes: Carded from corpus documentation rather than from a paper, so pdf_status is not-applicable. No DOI exists for the corpus or for the thesis. DATA LICENCE: none stated. Neither the Neural Engineering Data Consortium downloads page nor the overview page names a licence or a data use agreement; access is by signed form emailed to help@nedcdata.org and then ssh key and rsync at data/tuh_eeg/tuh_eeg_abnormal/v3.0.1. source.md is a composite of three retrieved documents, each delimited by an explicit banner: (1) the downloads page https://isip.piconepress.com/projects/nedc/html/tuh_eeg/ as plain text; (2) the overview page https://isip.piconepress.com/projects/tuh_eeg/html/overview.shtml as plain text; and (3) Silvia Lopez de Diego, 'Automated Interpretation of Abnormal Adult Electroencephalograms', MS thesis, Temple University, August 2017, which the downloads page names as the description of TUAB, downloaded as thesis_v31.docx from https://isip.piconepress.com/publications/ms_theses/2017/abnormal/thesis/thesis_v31.docx and converted with markitdown. The thesis carries a 2017 copyright notice and no licence; its markdown conversion is retained as internal research notes under fair use and no PDF is committed. md_quality is rough because of the third component: the docx conversion emitted base64 image payloads inline, all figures are lost including the age and gender histograms, and Tables 2 and 3 (the file statistics the card's counts come from) did not survive as tables -- the training and evaluation file counts on the card were read from the abstract's prose, which states them in words. The two HTML snapshots are clean. A per-corpus _AAREADME giving subject counts, channel counts and the partition definition exists inside the distributed release but is behind the registration wall; four candidate public URLs were probed and all returned HTTP 404. That gap is why several fixed fields on the card read unknown.
